result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback 90-day software/deliverable duration, but it does not provide the required repair, replacement, or refund remedies and omits warranties for professional and workmanlike services, legal compliance, and absence of malicious code. It also unnecessarily changes the trigger from delivery to acceptance, adds acceptance-criteria conformity, and broadly preserves every other remedy and claim period. The duplicated section number further reduces drafting quality.
